subject: gk
question:
With reference to the city administration of Mauryan Empire, consider the following statements.

a) Megasthenes put light on the Mauryan city administration.

b) The city council was divided into six committees.

c) City administration was well planned.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**a, b, c**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mauryan Empire had a well-organized and centralized administrative system.**
 
• Megasthenes put light on the Mauryan city administration.
 
 
• **This statement is correct**
 
• The city administration **was documented by Megasthenes and Kautilya. **
 
• Megasthenes **was a Greek ambassador to the court of Chandragupta Maurya** 
 
• He **lived in Pataliputra, which he called Palibothra, a Greek word meaning "city with gates" **
 
• **His book Indika provides information about the Mauryan administration **​
 
 
 
• **The city council was divided into six committees.**
 
 
• **​This statement is correct**
 
• The city council was divided **into six committees, each with five members **
 
• **Each committee was responsible for a specific area, such as industry, foreigners, trade, and manufactured goods **​
 
 
 
• **City administration was well planned.**
 
• ​This statement is correct
 
 
• The **Mauryan city administration was highly organized and well-planned,** with divisions for law, trade, military, and public welfare, as mentioned by historians and chroniclers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 __Mauryan Empire__

 
• The Maurya dynasty (321–185 BC) was a powerful dynasty in ancient India.
 
• The Maurya dynasty ruled India for 137 years.
 
• The credit for its establishment is given to Chandragupta Maurya and his minister Chanakya (Kautilya).
 
• This empire started from the plains of the Ganges river (today's Bihar and Bengal) in the state of Magadha in the east.
 
• Its capital was Pataliputra (near present-day Patna city).
 
• Chandragupta Maurya established this empire in 321 BC and rapidly expanded his empire towards the west.
